speaker: Doctor
text:
The CT angiography confirms a double aortic arch causing significant compression of the trachea and esophagus, which explains the stridor, wheezing, and feeding difficulties. This vascular ring is compressing the airway, particularly when the neck is flexed, and affecting swallowing, leading to post-feeding vomiting.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Double Aortic Arch
